title: 第8章 美女们“围攻”傻大壮
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
李大壮手上动作不停，同时冷声问张振生。

    “呵！一个傻子，还真惦记上我的副院长之位了！”张振生像是听到什么笑话似的，脸上的老褶都挤到了一起，大声嘲笑：“行！你要是真有这能耐，别说副院长了，我还愿意向你磕头拜师！”

    “这可是你说的！”李大壮似笑非笑的回头看了他一眼。

    不知道为啥，这傻子的一个眼神，竟让张振生莫名一慌！

    下一秒，他就听见了林晚禾倒抽气的声音：“缝，缝上了！真的缝上了！！”

    “什么！？不可能！！”

    张振生不敢置信的扑过去，果然看到李守义断掉的食指，竟然已经完好无损的回到了他的手上！

    更令他目瞪口呆的是，断指的连接处，竟然一点缝合的痕迹都没有，就好像这根手指从来没断过似的！

    “不！不可能！这根本不可能啊！”张振生狠狠的在自己脸上抽了两巴掌！

    疼！不是做梦！

    他见鬼了似的看着李大壮，李大壮却连个眼神都没给他，只是专心的继续缝合着下一根手指！

    倒是已经彻底惊呆的张桂芬和李秋霜，被张振生大耳刮子的声音给惊醒了，激动的浑身颤抖！

    “大壮真行！我儿子真行啊！这下可好了，不用去县医院花大钱，也能保住老头子的手指了！”

    “妈，大壮这回好了以后，本事更大了，以后你和我爸都可以放心了！”

    李大壮手指翻飞，又快又稳，没一会儿，就把父亲断掉的四根手指，全都接上了，而且全都没有缝合的痕迹，就和自己长上去似的，十分完美！

    “这，这简直太不可思议了！”林晚禾一直在近距离观察李大壮的动作，两团雪白贴在李大壮胳膊上，因为激动微微颤抖着，之前李大壮没心情感受，这会儿细细品味一下，其实两个圆润的触感不同，也是别有一番风味嘛！
content_en:
Li Dazhuang kept moving his hands and asked Zhang Zhensheng coldly.

    "Ha! What a fool, you really want to be my vice-dean!" Zhang Zhensheng seemed to have heard some joke, the old folds on his face were squeezed together, and he laughed loudly: "Okay! If you are really capable, let alone the vice-dean, I am willing to kowtow to you and become your disciple!"

    "That's what you said!" Li Dazhuang looked back at him with a half-smile.

    I don’t know why, but this fool’s look made Zhang Zhensheng panic inexplicably!

    The next second, he heard Lin Wanhe gasping: "It's sewn, it's sewn! It's really sewn!"

    "What!? Impossible!!"

    Zhang Zhensheng rushed over in disbelief and saw that Li Shouyi's broken index finger had returned to his hand intact!

    What shocked him even more was that there was no trace of suture at the joint of the severed finger, as if the finger had never been broken!

    "No! Impossible! This is simply impossible!" Zhang Zhensheng slapped himself hard twice on the face!

    pain! Not a dream!

    He looked at Li Dazhuang as if he had seen a ghost, but Li Dazhuang didn't even look at him. He just continued to sew the next finger attentively!

    However, Zhang Guifen and Li Qiu Shuang, who were already completely stunned, were awakened by the sound of Zhang Zhensheng scratching their ears, and their whole bodies were shaking with excitement!

    "Dazhuang is really good! My son is really good! Now it's great. We don't have to go to the county hospital and spend a lot of money, and we can save the old man's finger!"

    "Mom, after Da Zhuang recovers this time, he will be even more capable. You and my dad can rest assured in the future!"

    Li Dazhuang's fingers were flying quickly and steadily. In a short while, all four of his father's broken fingers were reattached, and there were no traces of stitches on them. It was as if they had grown on his own. They were perfect!

    "This, this is simply unbelievable!" Lin Wanhe has been observing Li Dazhuang's movements at close range. Two white balls of snow are stuck to Li Dazhuang's arms, trembling slightly with excitement. Li Dazhuang was not in the mood to feel it before. Now he savors it carefully. In fact, the two round touches are different, and they have a different flavor!
title_en: Chapter 8 The beauties "besiege" Sha Da Zhuang
